name: HPR-Bench
description: Personalized user understanding from large-scale digital traces remains a fundamental challenge. Traditional user profiling methods rely on discriminative models and manual feature engineering to predict discrete attributes, often producing fragmented and logically inconsistent profiles that generalize poorly to long-tail behaviors. In this work, we study a generative paradigm in which large language models (LLMs) summarize long and noisy behavioral histories into coherent narratives that capture nuanced user evolution.
